description: Find and open the agent-spawn entrypoint even if the visible button moves between shell regions, then verify the spawn affordance can be discovered without mutating live daemon state.
preconditions: The probe runs against a snapshot daemon or read-only dry-run spawn endpoint.
The adaptive locator may use accessible names, glossary components, app-native semantic hooks, and Stagehand observe output.
steps: Locate the spawn-agent affordance by semantic role rather than screen position.
Open the dialog or panel in dry-run mode.
Capture the chosen locator path for promotion or review.
assertions: The spawn affordance is discoverable by meaning, not fixed coordinates.
The probe writes locator evidence and a fragility score.
No real agent is spawned during verification.
staleIf: No glossary component owns the spawn affordance.
The adaptive probe repeatedly falls back to text-only or coordinate-only selection.
The worktree changes spawn-related components without updating this flow.
